metrics.label: Reusable components in the design system
Faster page loads via performance work

bioParagraphs: I led the frontend architecture redesign of a multi-role B2B platform at HUMBEE — serving distributors, dealers, retailers and manufacturers from a single React.js codebase — built its 30+ component design system, and cut page-load time by ~30% through lazy loading, code splitting and CDN caching.

Across five teams I've owned the full delivery loop: translating business requirements into features, securing platforms with JWT and RBAC, managing CI/CD pipelines with DevOps, and raising quality through testing and code reviews.

I'm an AWS Certified AI Practitioner, covering generative AI on AWS with Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker. I have hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Terraform, and I build GenAI tooling with Google ADK, RAG and LLM APIs.
summary: Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience building production web applications with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js. Led the redesign of a multi-role B2B platform, built a 30+ component design system and cut page-load time by ~30%. AWS Certified AI Practitioner (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker) with hands-on experience in cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform) and GenAI (Google ADK, RAG, LLM APIs). Open to relocation across Europe and to Bengaluru, Pune or Hyderabad.
